name: prism
description: Run the Prism beads-backed story lifecycle with Callee prism/* agents.

interface.shortDescription: Beads-backed story lifecycle with Callee agents.
interface.longDescription: Guides coding agents through the Prism story lifecycle with full lifecycle and direct phase commands: specify, design, plan, human gate, apply, and verify using bd and callee.
